title: Chapter 543
text:
It had been twenty days since Godora's guard fleet suffered the unexpected calamity.

After the previous incident, Godora's fleet was in a state of fear every day. The crew members did not even dare to go to the toilet for more than two minutes, afraid that they would follow in the footsteps of their commander, Barette, and end up with a face full of perfume.

Thankfully, Ames had gone to play somewhere else ten days ago. Even when she left Blue Star, Barette did not dare to protest in front of Ames. He was like a coward, swallowing his anger and sulking on his own.

Hella and Aurora did not leave with Ames. For the sake of disaster relief, the two of them remained in Blue Star.

However, they had accepted Ames' invitation and already had the title of 'Disciple of the Dragon Emperor'.

Ames understood the current situation of Blue Star and did not force the two of them to leave with her immediately. Both parties had reached an agreement that after the Mutation Disaster was resolved, Han Xiao would be responsible for sending Hella and Aurora to Floating Dragon Island to further their studies.

After witnessing Ames' strength, Hella understood the difference between herself and the top experts. The universe was filled with experts, and she deeply understood that she was still very weak. She would not be able to protect herself and her sister, so she naturally would not reject Ames' good intentions. It could also be understood that the sense of urgency brought about by her persecutory delusions was the source of her pursuit of strength.

In fact, when Han Xiao returned, Hella had already understood that her future would not be limited to Blue Star. There would be a day when she would step into a higher level. Her original plan was to put down her pride and bring her sister to follow Han Xiao into the universe. However, Ames' unexpected interference had become an even better opportunity.

Han Xiao was in agreement. Although Hella had talent, her combat strength could not keep up with his current level. Training under the Dragon Emperor should be able to stimulate her potential and quickly reach the level where she could be of help to him.

On the other hand, in the past month, the construction of the sub-base had basically been completed. The players had worked hard day and night and had already completed the transformation of the main city area of the sanctuary.

The main city was the area within the city walls, and new cables were installed there. The energy core of the shelter had also been replaced with a stable galactic-level high-energy reactor. A huge amount of energy was used to power the city-level shield that covered the main city and the hexagonal electromagnetic orbital cannon array.

On the day of completion, the Main City District was separated out and became 'Black Star Base No.2'. The area around the Main City District was expanded by the refugees, and it could be roughly divided into seven satellite cities. The area was a few times larger than the Main City District, and this area was named 'Black Phantom Shelter'. Base No.2 was far more advanced than Blue Star. It was impregnable, and even if the Six Nations attacked together, they wouldn't be able to do anything to the base.

The layout of the city was obvious. It was divided into the inner city of the base and the outer city of the sanctuary. This was the prototype of the Black Star Mercenary's stronghold in Blue Star.

Because of the abundant funds, most of the equipment in the base was bought. The advantage of spending money was that it saved time. Han Xiao built two production lines in his spare time. One was the electromagnetic guns that were quite powerful to the players, and the other was the low-level rechargeable shield. Both of them were suitable to be sold to the current players.

Although Base No.1 also had production lines for these two types of equipment, Base No.2 needed to have a certain level of production to increase the local production and prevent a shortage of supplies.

Currently, most of the players had already surpassed the limit of LV 60 and completed their first Race Evolution. The players continued to level up, causing Han Xiao's EXP to decrease temporarily. However, the wallets of the players gradually filled up, and Enas gradually replaced the original currency system.

Other than Mad Blade and the others, the other players also had some extra money. A small portion of the players could already afford the faction goods of the mercenary group. In the past month, these low-level mechanical goods had earned Han Xiao 380,000 Enas.

Although the overall spending power of the players was far lower than that of the professional players, it was still a good start.

After deducting the expenses of the production base, Han Xiao currently had 4.8 million Enas in his savings, including the 600,000 from the professional players.

Other than these two matters, the situation in Blue Star had been stable for the past month, and Godora's storm did not seem to affect this place.

The second stage of the Mutation Disaster was gradually being suppressed, and the progress of the players' Main Storyline Missions increased. Everything seemed to be taking a turn for the better, but Han Xiao knew that this was only the calm before the storm.

Today, the change finally arrived.

Godora had developed the antidote!

Nagojin secretly escorted the antidote back and immediately looked for Han Xiao.

"Black Star, the research department has created an antidote based on your sample, which is still in the experimental stage. Blue Star is the first area to test it."

Nagojin took out his communicator and opened an encrypted file. Inside was the information on the antidote, and he passed it to Han Xiao to take a look.

Han Xiao skimmed through it, and his eyes gleamed. "Two types of antidotes?"

"Yes, the research department discovered the workings of the Mutation Source through the sample and discovered that the Mutation Source's ability has some sort of radiation reaction. Thus, the first type of antidote is a mechanical device that can interfere with the Mutation Source's ability within a certain range, reducing the unique radiation reaction of the Mutation Source. The specific effect is to reduce the hormone level of the infected person during the outbreak, and the originally uncontrollable behavior of the infected person will become barely controllable. This can be understood as weakening the ability of the Mutation Source to control the infected person."

Nagojin explained.

Han Xiao nodded. "This way, as long as this device is deployed, the infected person within a radius of a few dozen miles will not need to be injected with the inhibitor."

The production of the inhibitor was far from enough to satisfy the needs of the refugees, and it could only be injected on an individual. However, the inhibitor that Godora had developed was an area inhibitor, and its efficiency was a million times higher. It could be said that it had solved the biggest problem.

Nagojin said with a deep voice, "The other type of antidote is a type of injection, and its effect is to destroy the molecular structure of the Mutation Source. As long as it is injected into the Mutation Source, it will be destroyed!"

The picture on the information was a tube of white colloidal solution.

"As expected …" Han Xiao's eyes narrowed.

The Mutation Source was able to absorb energy, and most attacks had limited effects on it. Its vitality was extremely strong, and as long as it was not completely destroyed, it would be able to grow again. This type of injection was the nemesis of the Mutation Source, and it would destroy the internal balance of the Mutation Source. Like a domino effect, it would cause the Mutation Source to disintegrate from the molecular level, causing the consciousness of the Mutation Source to disappear.

The second type of antidote was the true method to solve the Mutation Disaster!

Han Xiao suddenly had a thought. In the storyline of his previous life, the Mutation Source had grown to a relatively high level, and the energy it had stored up could be converted into combat strength. Countless players had cooperated with the people of Godora to deal with the Mutation Source. While there had only been one opponent, the Mutation Source had controlled countless beasts and infected people, and the scale of that battle had been extremely grand.

Right now, due to his influence, the battle had been brought forward by more than a year, and the Mutation Source was far from the standard of his previous life. This also meant that the difficulty of the Mutation Disaster had plummeted!

Han Xiao knocked on the table and said, "Then, our current mission is to find the Mutation Source of Blue Star. The chances of finding a needle in a haystack are too low. Do you have any other methods? "

"Yes! Apart from the two types of antidotes, the research department has also created a detector that can detect the Mutation Source's wavelength! As long as one stays within two thousand meters of the Mutation Source for more than ten seconds, the detector will be able to lock onto the Mutation Source's location. Sigh, time is limited, and the research department can only create such a detector. "

Nagojin took out a palm-sized device that looked like a radiation detector.

Han Xiao picked up the detector and said, "While it can only lock onto the Mutation Source's location within two thousand meters, it is much better than searching blindly. Oh, the structure of this detector is very simple."

"That's right. As long as we understand the theory behind the Mutation Source, it will be easy to create a detector, and the cost will not be high."

Han Xiao's face lit up with joy as he smelled a business opportunity. "That's great! Get the research department to pass the blueprint to me, and I will mass produce the detectors and distribute them to the Inhumans. After that, I will send them to different continents and different locations to conduct a carpet search! "

"Wouldn't it be faster to send out the spaceships?" Nagojin asked doubtfully.

"That might not be the case. The detector will only have a reaction within two thousand meters, and it can be seen as a two-thousand-meter sphere. As the altitude increases, the range of the detector will also decrease. At two thousand meters, only the tip of the sphere will be left, and the spaceships will have to fly at a very low altitude. Furthermore, within two thousand meters, the detector will have to wait for ten seconds before locking onto the Mutation Source's location. Thus, the spaceships can only fly at a low speed, or they will miss the Mutation Source. Don't forget that the Mutation Source can move as well. "

Han Xiao shook his head and said, "In comparison, it is better to organize people to search on the ground. Apart from the Inhumans, the armies of the Six Nations can also help. With sufficient manpower, we will not miss any areas."

Nagojin was stunned. While he felt that something was wrong, Han Xiao's words did make sense. He could only nod his head and say, "Then let's do as you say."

Han Xiao revealed a smile when he heard that.

All along, the Sanctuary and Godora could only passively provide disaster relief and were helpless against the Mutation Source. Now, everything was different!

With the three items that Godora had researched, they could finally take the initiative to eliminate the Mutation Disaster!

"This day has finally arrived!" Han Xiao's eyes gleamed with a sharp light.

Two days later, the Sanctuary and many cities of the Six Nations had deployed the Mutation Suppressant, and they were finally free from the restriction of the suppressant. During this period, there was a large-scale outbreak, which proved that the suppressant was indeed effective.

While the infected would still have all sorts of emotions, those with slightly stronger willpower would be able to suppress their impulses during the outbreak.

Willpower happened to be the forte of the Blue Star citizens who had been through so much.

Finally, the refugees who were protected by the various powers finally felt a sense of security and were no longer in a constant state of anxiety. While the Mutation Disaster had not been completely resolved, the citizens of Blue Star had finally seen the light of hope in the past few months.

The happiest person was naturally Yi Yeqing. She no longer had to work overtime to cultivate the ingredients for the suppressant and could finally relax.

With her free time, Yi Yeqing saw the smiles on the faces of the refugees for the first time. Her heart seemed to have been touched by something, and she realized that her actions had saved so many lives.

This kind of feeling made her feel very special and warm.

Bennett and the upper echelons of the Six Nations also heaved a sigh of relief. They did not know the inside story of Han Xiao's contribution and thought that it was all Godora's work. Thus, they all expressed their gratitude to Nagojin, the commander of Godora's Disaster Relief Team.

This made Nagojin feel very awkward, and he felt a little weird. The biggest contributor was Blue Star's people, but they were thanking him. It was like putting the cart before the horse!

However, while he was ridiculing this bunch of Blue Star's people in his heart, he was determined to abide by the confidentiality rules and did not reveal Han Xiao's actions to outsiders.

In the eyes of the players, the storyline was naturally not that complicated. They only knew that Godora had suddenly developed a suppressant, causing the progress of the Main Storyline Mission to decrease by the day.

Right at this juncture, the Black Star Mercenary suddenly released a large-scale mission that attracted the attention of all the players.

Finding the source

Mission Introduction: The Mutation Disaster is the source of the calamity, and the unknown fate has caused everyone to feel uneasy. Finally, the day that countless people have been waiting for has arrived. Black Star has found a way to eradicate the disaster, and he needs your help.

Mission Requirements: You will be randomly placed in a certain location of Blue Star. Use the Mutation Source Detector to find the location of the Blue Star Mutation Source and inform the Black Star Mercenary.

Mission Reward: 105 Experience, 10000 Enas, 1,500 Black Star Mercenary Favorability, 1 Sunil NCO Class Reconnaissance Armor

Note: This mission will affect the progress of the Mutation Disaster Main Storyline Mission and greatly increase the progress of the Mutation Disaster Mission.

"The f * ck, this mission reward is so high!"

"Ten thousand Enas! Oh my god! "

"It can even affect the progress of the Main Storyline Mission. Seems like this is a very important mission."

"Could this be a sign that the Mutation Disaster Main Storyline Mission is coming to an end?"

This mission caused a huge uproar on the Blue Star forums, and it immediately caused a commotion among the players!

To the players at this stage of the game, the reward for this mission that Han Xiao had given out was simply too high!

Han Xiao's reward had increased along with his strength and influence, and it had become extremely high!

A little over a million Experience Points was very impressive, but this was not the main point. The main point was that the 10,000 Enas was equivalent to a few hundred daily disaster relief missions!

Not only that, the faction relationship with the Black Star Mercenary was also very valuable. At the end of the mission, there was even a set of NCO Class armor that was worth a few thousand Enas. This was the set of armor that the top players were wearing, and the majority of the players had been envious of it for a long time!

Such a generous reward stimulated the nerves of countless people, and the millions of players were all excited.

It was not an exaggeration to say that this was the mission with the most generous reward that they had ever seen!

A substantial reward was more useful than any number of mission introductions, and the players swarmed toward the Black Star Mercenary's stronghold to accept the mission. They almost broke through the door.

Very quickly, the players found out from the Black Star Mercenary that the mission to locate the Mutation Source required a special item that could be purchased from the faction store. Furthermore, this mission was open to all players, and anyone had the right to purchase it.

Countless players could not wait to open the faction store and find their target. Very quickly, the item information appeared before their eyes.
